summary: The window of volatile live QoS 0 frames of one connection in the owner of the default single-owner runtime (Owner::plan_qos0_continue, VolatileQueue; record 0063): a bounded window released by write receipts, bounded parking that drops the newest, the wire order of each connection, and service of a fast subscriber while another socket stalls. With --delivery-shards K >= 1 volatile QoS 0 is delegated to the delivery shards and is outside the model.
not_replayed: No test drives a mutant: the tests state the order and the bounds of the unmutated code. The control frame that competes for the output queue (Control, mut-window) has no deterministic replay; the room it needs is the compile-time assertion QOS0_WINDOW + QOS0_OUTPUT_RESERVE == OUTPUT_SLOTS in net.rs.
